usedFor: LiveChat holds your conversations, and MSG91 sends the follow-up when “Finished Chat” runs “Send a Mail” from a template.

bestTemplate.name: “Finished Chat” in LiveChat, then “Send a Mail” in MSG91
bestTemplate.why: When a chat ends, the customer gets a templated mail, so the conversation closes with a next step.

watchOut: A mail to a customer waits in Needs you for your approval before “Send a Mail” goes out.
